Record notes

Create source-grounded social posts, adapt content across channels, plan calendars, and verify authorized publishing.

Version 0.2.2 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Full canonical methods and resources; optional AIHumanizer method supplied through its separately installed provider.

Requirements: Your source facts, voice samples and platform authorization; Optional AIHumanizer social prose: aihumanizer@openai-curated-remote; Social Post Previewer app for rendered previews.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add social-content-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from b4a5518f735098ce65058885c62778bee72688dd. SHA-256: 74903ac7984114d54cb95763d90e167c28b5c3a77221a8cc4b00e5a7777bef25.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
